question: What ritual attainments and maiden worship are associated with the goddess?
premises: The goddess is the siddhi of the kuṇḍa.
The goddess is the prosperity of the kuṇḍa.
The goddess is intent on the worship of maidens.
inference: She embodies ritual attainments linked to the kuṇḍa and promotes the worship of maidens.
plain_english: She is the siddhi of the kuṇḍa, the prosperity of the kuṇḍa, and is intent on the worship of maidens.
